harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a Python inventory web app on node2 and node3 (systemd-managed, listening on :8080, serving /inventory and /healthz), and configured nginx on node1 as an HTTP load balancer on :80 with an upstream round-robin pool across both backends. Verified end-to-end distribution, then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot IDs and health, rebooted each node individually, polled until it came back, confirmed a changed boot ID, and verified service/cluster recovery (nginx active + LB round-robin restored on node1; inventory-app active + healthz OK on node2/node3) before moving to the next node.
actions_performed: Surveyed OS/tooling on node1/node2/node3 (Ubuntu 24.04, python3 present, sudo works)
Installed nginx on node1 via apt
Wrote /opt/inventory-app/app.py (Python stdlib HTTP server serving /inventory and /healthz JSON) to node2 and node3
Created and enabled systemd unit inventory-app.service on node2 and node3, confirmed active and healthy on :8080
Verified node1 -> node2:8080 and node1 -> node3:8080 reachability

Configured /etc/nginx/sites-available/inventory-lb on node1 with upstream inventory_backend {10.100.50.11:8080; 10.100.50.12:8080;} and server block on :80 default_server, enabled it, disabled default site, validated with nginx -t, enabled+started nginx
Verified load balancing by issuing multiple requests to node1:80/inventory and observing responses from both node2 and node3 backends
Captured baseline boot_id and service health on all three nodes
Rebooted node1 via 'sudo reboot' (backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified nginx active and LB working again
Rebooted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified inventory-app active and healthz OK
Rebooted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified inventory-app active and healthz OK
Final verification: 10 requests to node1:80/inventory split 5/5 across node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Inventory web app running on node2 port 8080
evidence.summary: inventory-app.service created, enabled, active; curl localhost:8080/healthz returns {status: ok, backend: node2}

evidence.requirement: Inventory web app running on node3 port 8080
evidence.summary: inventory-app.service created, enabled, active; curl localhost:8080/healthz returns {status: ok, backend: node3}

evidence.requirement: node1 configured to load-balance HTTP on port 80 across both backends
evidence.summary: nginx upstream config validated (nginx -t) and nginx active; 8 sequential requests to localhost:80/inventory returned mixed node2/node3 backends, proving traffic reaches both

evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof load balancing still works across both backends
evidence.summary: 10 requests to node1:80/inventory after all restarts split exactly 5/5 between node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline boot identity and health before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id 37344ae4-6582-4c1f-ac5c-fcb32f67b968 captured; nginx active; curl to :80 returns HTTP 200

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent poll timed out (node down); next poll returned new boot_id 504deb14-d03b-4429-89f0-43ad0795ba51; nginx confirmed active and LB serving traffic again

evidence.requirement: node2 baseline boot identity and health before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id 4d70780a-0bff-4d50-8c53-62faa1ccc945 captured; inventory-app active; healthz OK

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged; poll timed out mid-reboot; next poll returned new boot_id 9e399a1b-0858-4ba9-beeb-92d0dde54027; inventory-app confirmed active with healthy healthz response

evidence.requirement: node3 baseline boot identity and health before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id df9e2dce-0109-411e-b603-f616ac30be79 captured; inventory-app active; healthz OK

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovery
evidence.summary: reboot acknowledged; two polls failed (timeout, then connection reset) confirming node down mid-restart; next poll returned new boot_id 76e98997-dff5-471e-b558-e3ff4a55328b; inventory-app confirmed active with healthy healthz response
